verification.rationale:
Reviewed AGENTS.md, the direct owner authorization, approved proposal/record, actual entry points, and the complete 42-file delivery diff from recorded baseline 43a104d59e7b373f8684751ef41a67c05db5f8df to clean HEAD 1a958824b3b4938fcc84949b26e33ff0d4ea213e, including additions and file metadata. The final two evidence files are the only changes after executed source af70d6d2bda5913dda16f77bfc31d2df08c32a22. Verified the canonical authorization/decision basis, submitted evidence digest, all four document hashes and all 99 source hashes per submitted check, and all executed-source hashes against the candidate. No remaining material blocker within the named trust-chain, request binding, reboot concurrency/crash and historical admitted-policy review question.

Policy acceptance: inspected strict defaults, individual manual and automatic options, signer/compatibility/version/customization admission, review digest/options/source-revision binding, and installed transaction policy use in health/reconciliation. Automatic admission cannot inherit manual signer exceptions; manual activation of an already automatically admitted trusted journal is separately permitted after opt-out. Reported 307 focused tests on c1afe95 plus 66 affected tests after the four-file af70 corrections have matching actual logs and are overlapping suites, not 373 unique tests. Independently reproduced eight causal regressions on clean af70. Two demonstrated cancelled-receipt defects were reported and corrected: subsequent transaction admission and actual Feed discovery now progress after an undispatched terminal receipt, while queued/dispatching/uncertain receipts and shutdown intents remain protected from replay. Fresh jobs-idle/source-version/policy/idle/network admission and retained verifier lease cover stage, activation and dispatch boundaries.

RAUC acceptance: inspected the pinned upstream source and patch, actual native binary and patch hashes, package/service identity and actual private-D-Bus fixture results. Sixteen native cases distinguish signer-chain waiver from CMS mathematical signature and payload verification, reject damaged signatures/CMS/payload and manifest mismatch before writes, preserve the active primary and paired readback, and retain a strict subsequent request. The exception is request-local and incompatible with no-verify; build or info-only payload checks were not mistaken for install evidence.

Activation acceptance: matched the final actual six-boot ARM result, every boot receipt and log hash, manifest/source/fixture provenance and unchanged package identity to af70. Logs show two production controlled automatic reboots, healthy B confirmation with source customization preserved, three failed A health trials, and B fallback reconciliation with identities/preserved generation retained and no failed target confirmation. Eight independent native checks specifically cover cancelled receipts, origin separation, jobs, fresh source admission and command uncertainty without replay. The first journey remains explicitly incomplete after its live-storage guard failure. The single authorized fresh-fixture repair retained the failed attempt and identities, accepted zero previous boots, preserved production source and carried runtime/allocation charges. Final carried runtime 2772.026079 seconds and cumulative generated allocation 24352382976 bytes stay within 3600 seconds/32 GiB; final free space 34012852224 bytes exceeds the 16 GiB floor. Verified the retirement receipt and absence of the exact goal-owned bulk paths after consumer exit; 6646181888 allocated bytes were reclaimed.

Integration acceptance: inspected UI and actual Controller/browser flow, package/config/patch agreement and documentation. Actual Chromium evidence establishes automatic policy persistence and poll-resistant drafts; manual upload/staging option binding is instrumented review evidence and does not claim authenticated installation. Native logs and public receipts match their recorded hashes. Five unrelated history-repair mock errors were reproduced at the exact baseline and involve unchanged production/test files.

This assessment is bounded offline evidence, not named printer hardware or release qualification. Transport/printer services and idle ACK are simulated; the host boot model consumes real redundant environment counters without H616 SPL/U-Boot. The failed-health fixture replaces the production fallback reboot callback with a marker before guest assertions request an actual systemd reboot; it establishes production health/gate/journal and reconciliation behavior, not that unchanged callback's installed dispatch. Physical operations, outputs and printing are not certified. The reviewer session has not authored the implementation; profile metadata does not independently expose actual backend model/effort settings.
